events.title: Play the Billy the Hero Demo Now! - Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hello everyone! The wait is finally over! I am incredibly excited to announce that the Billy the Hero Demo is officially LIVE on Steam as part of Steam Next Fest! We Need Your Feedback! As an independent solo developer, your feedback is absolutely essential. Whether you encounter technical issues, have suggestions for balance, or just want to share your thoughts, I want to hear it all! Please drop your feedback in our official Steam Community Hub: 🔗 https://steamcommunity.com/app/3594550/discuss
